content.short: Uniswap v4 hook whose pool fees rise automatically when volatility spikes, plus pools that double as lending markets.
content.description: Aegis came out of the Uniswap Foundation's Hook Design Lab. Its Dynamic Fee Manager lets liquidity providers earn a swap fee that climbs when markets turn volatile, which is when LPs lose most to informed traders. A second product, the Liquidity Engine, turns a pool into a lending market, so LPs collect lending interest on top of swap fees and others can borrow against the pool. Its pools hold around $6 million in liquidity.
content.meta: Aegis builds Uniswap v4 hooks with volatility-based dynamic fees and pools that also act as lending markets.
